title: A Finger-Sized Shrimp Snaps Louder Than a Gunshot
subject: pistol shrimp

scenes.text: This shrimp is smaller than your finger, and its snap is louder than a gunshot.
It has one oversized claw. When it snaps shut, a bubble shoots out at over 100 kilometers an hour.
Then the bubble collapses. The pop measures about 218 decibels.
For a split second, the heat inside that bubble reaches thousands of degrees Fahrenheit.
The shockwave stuns small prey nearby, and the shrimp never even touches it.
No gun. Just one claw, one bubble, and one collapse.
